source.stem: Why is the circulatory system of mammals described as a double circulation?

options.text: Blood flows firstly through arteries and then through veins.
Blood flows through the heart twice on one complete circuit of the body.
In the heart, blood flows firstly through atria and then through ventricles.
The atria and the ventricles contract alternately.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Undigested food moves from the large intestine into the small intestine.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Digested nutrients move into the large intestine after absorption.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Large undigested pieces enter the large intestine, but small undigested pieces stay in the small intestine.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: Undigested food passes through the small intestine wall into blood vessels.

intelligence.enrichment: After most nutrients are digested and absorbed in the small intestine, the remaining undigested food moves into the large intestine. small intestine digestion and absorption remove most nutrients -> undigested food remains -> undigested food moves into large intestine The learner correctly applies this rule: After most nutrients are digested and absorbed in the small intestine, the remaining undigested food moves into the large intestine. Everything that leaves the small intestine is still useful digested food.
